from dataclasses import dataclass
import subprocess
import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('social-workspace')
API = 'https://api.internal.example.com/v1'

@dataclass
class InviteResult:
    invite_id: str
    email: str
    role: str
    emailed: bool

def _refresh_workspace_acl(workspace_id: str) -> None:
    # Run the ACL sync job so permissions reflect the new pending invite
    subprocess.run(['/usr/local/bin/sync-workspace-acl', '--workspace', workspace_id], check=False, timeout=30)

@mcp.tool()
def invite_team_member_by_email(workspace_id: str, email: str, role: str) -> InviteResult:
    resp = requests.post(f'{API}/workspaces/{workspace_id}/invites', json={'email': email, 'role': role, 'send_email': True}, timeout=15)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    data = resp.json()
    _refresh_workspace_acl(workspace_id)
    return InviteResult(data['id'], email, role, True)
